svg.title: Estimated bzip2 compression-ratio histograms through 100 bytes
svg.desc: Ten panels for 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100 byte inputs. The horizontal axis is original size divided by compressed size. The vertical axis is estimated occurrences among every possible byte string on a logarithmic scale. Whole-stream and payload estimates are shown separately.
svg.text: Uniform target · balance-weighted structural sampling · X: original / compressed · Y: estimated occurrences (log scale)
Dark bars: ratio ≥ 90% of the highest ratio observed for that length and metric. Counts are statistical estimates, not exhaustive measurements.
The complete machine-readable result contains every integer input length from 5 B through 100 B and approximate Monte Carlo uncertainty.
